info.title: PulseDesk API
info.description:
Multi-tenant API for trainers, clubs and schools: trainees, classes, weekly schedules,
sessions, attendance and fees.

**Authentication.** Every route is guarded by default. Send the access token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`; obtain one from `POST /api/auth/login`. The routes under
`/api/health` and the login, refresh, logout and password-reset routes under `/api/auth` are the
only public ones; `GET /api/auth/memberships` needs a token like every other route. The access
token is short-lived — `POST /api/auth/refresh` rotates it using the opaque refresh token. A
browser sends that token as an httpOnly cookie; any other client may send it in the request body
instead, and then the rotated pair comes back in the response body.

**Tenancy.** A caller selects the tenant to act in with the `X-Tenant-Id` header. For a
tenant-bound user it must name a tenant they hold a membership in — 403 otherwise — and the
request's effective role becomes that membership's role. For a `SUPER_ADMIN`, who holds no
membership, it must name an existing active tenant — 404 otherwise. Omit the header and the
token's own `role` and `tenantId` claims stand.

**Pagination.** Top-level list routes accept `page`/`pageSize` (default 25, max 100) and
return `{ items, page, pageSize, total, totalPages }`. Parent-scoped sub-lists — a trainee's
contacts, a fee's payments, a session's attendances, the `me/*` routes — return plain arrays.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, token refresh, logout and the password-reset flow. Public.

tags.name: Memberships
tags.description: The signed-in user's tenant memberships, for the tenant picker.

tags.name: Tenants
tags.description: Clubs and schools. SUPER_ADMIN only, reads included.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Staff and customer accounts, their roles and location assignments.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Venues within a tenant. Writes are SUPER_ADMIN only.

tags.name: Classes
tags.description: Training groups, their billing mode and their trainer/trainee rosters.

tags.name: Trainees
tags.description: Trainee records. Creating a trainee under 18 requires at least one contact.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Guardian contacts belonging to one trainee.

tags.name: ClassSchedules
tags.description: Recurring weekly slots, and the flow that materialises sessions from them.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Concrete dated sessions and their per-session trainer roster.

tags.name: Attendances
tags.description: Attendance marking, bulk updates, the customer RSVP route and the customer's own session list.

tags.name: Fees
tags.description: Charges raised against a trainee, including the bulk generators.

tags.name: CustomerFees
tags.description: A customer's own fees, for the portal.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: The manual payment ledger recorded against a fee.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated fee and cash-flow figures for the charts.
